title: Remove and unplug Controller PCA in a tipper station (Controller PCA Replacement — Removal)
summary: Safely remove the Controller PCA from an OptiSweep tipper station by applying LOTO, accessing the controller box, loosening the controller box mounting screws, removing the ribbon cable retainer screws, and unplugging the PCA connections (FFC, ribbon cable, and three Molex connectors) so the assembly is ready for replacement.
when_to_use: When performing Controller PCA Replacement — Removal on an OptiSweep tipper station and you must remove/unplug the Controller PCA connections for replacement.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Perform on-site LOTO and disassembly steps to remove the Controller PCA and unplug PCA connections.
safety_notes: Apply LOTO to the tipper before touching internal components.
access_or_tools_needed: Physical access to the tipper station
LOTO capability for the tipper (per referenced "Operator Station Lockout/Tagout" on page 2)

access_required: On-site physical access to the tipper station
system_preconditions: Tipper is LOTO before internal disassembly
external_references: Operator Station Lockout/Tagout (referenced on page 2 of the manual)

visual_references.description: Figure 7-19: Controller PCA diagram showing controller box, four M8 button-head screws, ribbon cable retainer, and PCA connection points (FFC/ribbon cable/three Molex connectors).

steps.title: Apply LOTO to the tipper
steps.purpose: Ensure the tipper is safely locked out before touching internal components.
steps.instruction: Perform LOTO on the tipper using the referenced "Operator Station Lockout/Tagout" procedure (page 2).
steps.expected_result: The tipper is locked out (LOTO confirmed) before proceeding to internal components.
steps.healthy_condition: LOTO is confirmed applied to the tipper prior to any internal access.
steps.failure_condition: You cannot confirm LOTO is applied to the tipper before touching internal components.

actions.label: Perform LOTO
actions.exact_action: LOTO the tipper (see "Operator Station Lockout/Tagout" on page 2).

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop if you cannot confirm LOTO is applied to the tipper before touching internal components.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: 7.3.18.1: REMOVAL step 1: "LOTO the tipper (see \"Operator Station Lockout/Tagout\" on page 2)."

steps.title: Remove the station side panel if needed to access the motor
steps.purpose: Provide access to the controller box and mounting hardware inside the tipper station.
steps.instruction: If necessary, use a 3/8-in. wrench or socket to remove the nine (9) self-tapping securing screws for the station side panel, then remove the station side panel to access the motor.
steps.expected_result: Station side panel is removed (when needed) and the motor access area is reachable.
steps.healthy_condition: Side panel is removed cleanly using the specified nine (9) self-tapping securing screws (3/8-in. wrench/socket).
steps.failure_condition: Side panel cannot be removed as expected (e.g., screws count does not match nine (9) self-tapping securing screws).

actions.label: Check if side panel removal is needed
actions.exact_action: If necessary, use a 3/8-in. wrench or socket to remove the nine (9) self-tapping securing the side panel then remove the station side panel to access the motor.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: 7.3.18.1: REMOVAL step 2: "If necessary, use a 3/8-in. wrench or socket to remove the nine (9) self-tapping securing the side panel then remove the station side panel to access the motor."

steps.title: Loosen the four M8 button-head screws to release the controller box
steps.purpose: Free the controller box so it can be lifted off the fasteners without removing the fasteners.
steps.instruction: Loosen the four (4) M8 button-head screws that secure the controller box. Do not remove the fasteners—loosen them so the controller box can be lifted off the fasteners.
steps.expected_result: Controller box is released such that it can be lifted off after loosening the four (4) M8 button-head screws.
steps.healthy_condition: All four (4) M8 button-head screws are loosened (not removed) and the controller box can be lifted off the fasteners.
steps.failure_condition: Controller box cannot be lifted after loosening the four (4) M8 button-head screws (do not force).

actions.label: Loosen controller box screws
actions.exact_action: Loosen the four (4) M8 button-head screws to release the controller box. The fasteners do not need to be removed, only loosened, and the box can be lifted off the fasteners.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop if the controller box cannot be lifted after loosening the four M8 button-head screws (do not force).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: 7.3.18.1: REMOVAL step 3: "Loosen the four (4) M8 button-head screws to release the controller box. The fasteners do not need to be removed, only loosened, and the box can be lifted off the fasteners."

steps.title: Remove the two M3 socket-head screws holding the ribbon cable retainer
steps.purpose: Release the ribbon cable retainer so the ribbon cable connection can be unplugged.
steps.instruction: Remove the two (2) M3 socket-head screws holding the ribbon cable retainer in place.
steps.expected_result: Ribbon cable retainer is released after removing the two (2) M3 socket-head screws.
steps.healthy_condition: Both M3 socket-head screws are removed and the retainer is free to release the ribbon cable.
steps.failure_condition: Screws/retainers do not match the documented counts (2x M3) or the retainer does not release as expected.

actions.label: Remove ribbon cable retainer screws
actions.exact_action: Remove the two (2) M3 socket-head screws holding the ribbon cable retainer in place.

stop_or_escalate_if: Escalate to FORTNA support if screws/retainers do not match the documented counts (4x M8, 2x M3).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: 7.3.18.1: REMOVAL step 4: "Remove the two (2) M3 socket-head screws holding the ribbon cable retainer in place."

steps.title: Unplug all PCA connections (FFC, ribbon cable, and three Molex connectors)
steps.purpose: Disconnect the Controller PCA from all electrical/mechanical connections so it can be removed and replaced.
steps.instruction: Unplug all connections from the PCA: FFC, ribbon cable, and the three Molex connectors.
steps.expected_result: All PCA connections are unplugged: FFC and ribbon cable are disconnected, and three Molex connectors are unplugged.
steps.healthy_condition: Connections unplug without excessive force; the PCA connection points are visibly disconnected (FFC/ribbon cable removed from their connection points; three Molex connectors unplugged).
steps.failure_condition: Any PCA connections cannot be unplugged without excessive force.

actions.label: Unplug PCA connections
actions.exact_action: Unplug all the connections from the PCA (FFC, ribbon cable, three Molex connectors).

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop if any PCA connections cannot be unplugged without excessive force or if screws/retainers do not match the documented counts (4x M8, 2x M3).
Escalate to FORTNA support if any PCA connections cannot be unplugged without excessive force or if screws/retainers do not match the documented counts (4x M8, 2x M3).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: 7.3.18.1: REMOVAL step 5: "Unplug all the connections from the PCA (FFC, ribbon cable, three Molex connectors)."

success_criteria: LOTO is applied to the tipper before internal access.
Station side panel is removed (if needed) to access the motor/controller box area.
Controller box is released after loosening four (4) M8 button-head screws (fasteners loosened, not removed).
Ribbon cable retainer is released after removing two (2) M3 socket-head screws.
All PCA connections are unplugged: FFC, ribbon cable, and three Molex connectors.
healthy_conditions: Controller box can be lifted off after loosening the four (4) M8 button-head screws (no forcing).
Ribbon cable retainer releases after removing the two (2) M3 socket-head screws.
FFC/ribbon cable and three Molex connectors unplug without excessive force.
failure_conditions: LOTO cannot be confirmed before touching internal components.
Controller box cannot be lifted after loosening the four (4) M8 button-head screws.
Ribbon cable retainer screws/retainer do not match the documented counts (2x M3).
Any PCA connections cannot be unplugged without excessive force.
escalation_guidance: Escalate to FORTNA support if any PCA connections cannot be unplugged without excessive force or if screws/retainers do not match the documented counts (4x M8, 2x M3).
